title: AI Control Plane — Usage & Cost
description: Per-tenant AI spend from the usage_events ledger. Unpriced calls are surfaced separately: a model with no pricing entry records cost_usd=0 with cost_known=false, so whenever that count is non-zero the totals here understate real spend.

list.name: tenant
list.label: Tenant
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT tenant FROM usage_events ORDER BY 1

list.name: user
list.label: User
list.description: Exact subject_user id; empty means all users. Free text rather than a dropdown: enumerating ids would scan every row of usage_events, and the list is unbounded.

list.name: module
list.label: Module
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT coalesce(nullif(module, ''), '(unattributed)') FROM usage_events ORDER BY 1

list.name: feature
list.label: Feature
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT coalesce(nullif(feature, ''), '(unlabelled)') FROM usage_events WHERE tenant IN ($tenant) AND coalesce(nullif(module, ''), '(unattributed)') IN ($module) ORDER BY 1

list.name: modality
list.label: Modality
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT modality FROM usage_events ORDER BY 1

list.name: entity_type
list.label: Entity type
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT coalesce(entity_type, '(none)') FROM usage_events ORDER BY 1

targets.rawSql:
SELECT coalesce(sum(cost_usd), 0) AS "Total cost"
FROM usage_events
WHERE tenant IN ($tenant)
  AND coalesce(nullif(module, ''), '(unattributed)') IN ($module)
  AND coalesce(nullif(feature, ''), '(unlabelled)') IN ($feature)
  AND (${user:sqlstring} = '' OR subject_user = ${user:sqlstring})
  AND modality IN ($modality)
  AND coalesce(entity_type, '(none)') IN ($entity_type)
  AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at)

panels.title: Unpriced calls
panels.description: Calls whose model had no pricing entry (cost_known=false). Their real cost is UNKNOWN, not zero — any non-zero value here means 'Total cost' is an underestimate. Fix by adding the model to pricing.toml.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN cost_known THEN 0 ELSE 1 END), 0) AS "Unpriced calls"
FROM usage_events
WHERE tenant IN ($tenant)
  AND coalesce(nullif(module, ''), '(unattributed)') IN ($module)
  AND coalesce(nullif(feature, ''), '(unlabelled)') IN ($feature)
  AND (${user:sqlstring} = '' OR subject_user = ${user:sqlstring})
  AND modality IN ($modality)
  AND coalesce(entity_type, '(none)') IN ($entity_type)
  AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at)

SELECT count(*) AS "Calls"
FROM usage_events
WHERE tenant IN ($tenant)
  AND coalesce(nullif(module, ''), '(unattributed)') IN ($module)
  AND coalesce(nullif(feature, ''), '(unlabelled)') IN ($feature)
  AND (${user:sqlstring} = '' OR subject_user = ${user:sqlstring})
  AND modality IN ($modality)
  AND coalesce(entity_type, '(none)') IN ($entity_type)
  AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at)

panels.title: Prompt cache hit rate (LLM)
panels.description: Share of input tokens served from the provider's prompt cache. Cached input bills at roughly a tenth of the normal input rate, so this is the cheapest lever on spend — a high rate on a large shared prompt is where the savings are.

targets.rawSql:
-- LLM only: speech and image rows have no prompt tokens, and including them
-- would drag this toward zero for reasons that have nothing to do with caching.
-- Both operands are cast: CockroachDB's sum() over BIGINT yields DECIMAL,
-- and it rejects float/decimal division that Postgres would silently coerce.
SELECT CASE WHEN coalesce(sum(input_tokens), 0) = 0 THEN 0
            ELSE sum(cached_input_tokens)::float / sum(input_tokens)::float END AS "Cache hit rate"
FROM usage_events
WHERE tenant IN ($tenant)
  AND coalesce(nullif(module, ''), '(unattributed)') IN ($module)
  AND coalesce(nullif(feature, ''), '(unlabelled)') IN ($feature)
  AND (${user:sqlstring} = '' OR subject_user = ${user:sqlstring})
  AND modality = 'llm'
  AND coalesce(entity_type, '(none)') IN ($entity_type)
  AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at)

panels.title: Unattributed calls
panels.description: Calls with no user recorded. Expected for cron/backfill work; unexpectedly high means a caller is dropping the request context before the AI call and per-user cost is being lost.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) AS "Unattributed"
FROM usage_events
WHERE tenant IN ($tenant)
  AND coalesce(nullif(module, ''), '(unattributed)') IN ($module)
  AND coalesce(nullif(feature, ''), '(unlabelled)') IN ($feature)
  AND (${user:sqlstring} = '' OR subject_user = ${user:sqlstring})
  AND modality IN ($modality)
  AND coalesce(entity_type, '(none)') IN ($entity_type)
  AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
  AND coalesce(subject_user, '') = ''

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(occurred_at, $__interval),
       coalesce(nullif(module, ''), '(unattributed)') AS metric,
       sum(cost_usd) AS cost
FROM usage_events
WHERE tenant IN ($tenant)
  AND coalesce(nullif(module, ''), '(unattributed)') IN ($module)
  AND coalesce(nullif(feature, ''), '(unlabelled)') IN ($feature)
  AND (${user:sqlstring} = '' OR subject_user = ${user:sqlstring})
  AND modality IN ($modality)
  AND coalesce(entity_type, '(none)') IN ($entity_type)
  AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

SELECT coalesce(nullif(module, ''), '(unattributed)') AS module,
       sum(cost_usd) AS cost
FROM usage_events
WHERE tenant IN ($tenant)
  AND coalesce(nullif(module, ''), '(unattributed)') IN ($module)
  AND coalesce(nullif(feature, ''), '(unlabelled)') IN ($feature)
  AND (${user:sqlstring} = '' OR subject_user = ${user:sqlstring})
  AND modality IN ($modality)
  AND coalesce(entity_type, '(none)') IN ($entity_type)
  AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY cost DESC

SELECT coalesce(nullif(feature, ''), '(unlabelled)') AS feature,
       sum(cost_usd) AS cost
FROM usage_events
WHERE tenant IN ($tenant)
  AND coalesce(nullif(module, ''), '(unattributed)') IN ($module)
  AND coalesce(nullif(feature, ''), '(unlabelled)') IN ($feature)
  AND (${user:sqlstring} = '' OR subject_user = ${user:sqlstring})
  AND modality IN ($modality)
  AND coalesce(entity_type, '(none)') IN ($entity_type)
  AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY cost DESC

SELECT provider, sum(cost_usd) AS cost
FROM usage_events
WHERE tenant IN ($tenant)
  AND coalesce(nullif(module, ''), '(unattributed)') IN ($module)
  AND coalesce(nullif(feature, ''), '(unlabelled)') IN ($feature)
  AND (${user:sqlstring} = '' OR subject_user = ${user:sqlstring})
  AND modality IN ($modality)
  AND coalesce(entity_type, '(none)') IN ($entity_type)
  AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY cost DESC

-- Volume is reported in the unit each call was billed in: tokens for LLM,
-- seconds for speech-to-text, characters for text-to-speech. A pronunciation
-- user has no tokens at all, so a tokens-only column would read as broken.
SELECT coalesce(nullif(subject_user, ''), '(unattributed)') AS "user",
       count(*) AS calls,
       sum(input_tokens + output_tokens) AS tokens,
       round(sum(audio_seconds)::numeric, 1) AS audio_seconds,
       sum(characters) AS characters,
       sum(cost_usd) AS cost_usd
FROM usage_events
WHERE tenant IN ($tenant)
  AND coalesce(nullif(module, ''), '(unattributed)') IN ($module)
  AND coalesce(nullif(feature, ''), '(unlabelled)') IN ($feature)
  AND (${user:sqlstring} = '' OR subject_user = ${user:sqlstring})
  AND modality IN ($modality)
  AND coalesce(entity_type, '(none)') IN ($entity_type)
  AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY cost_usd DESC
LIMIT 50

panels.title: By model
panels.description: unpriced > 0 means this model is missing from pricing.toml and its spend is not being counted anywhere.

targets.rawSql:
-- One volume column, in whatever unit the model bills. unit is GROUPED rather
-- than reduced with max(): a model does NOT always bill one way. scribe_v2
-- records 312,861 calls in 'seconds' and 143 in 'tokens', and max() returns
-- 'tokens' because it sorts later — reporting the volume of the biggest STT
-- model as a token count of zero and hiding 1.8M seconds of audio. A model that
-- genuinely bills one way still produces exactly one row.
SELECT model,
       provider,
       max(modality) AS modality,
       count(*) AS calls,
       sum(CASE WHEN cost_known THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS unpriced,
       CASE unit
         WHEN 'seconds'    THEN round(sum(audio_seconds)::numeric, 1)
         WHEN 'characters' THEN sum(characters)::numeric
         ELSE sum(input_tokens + output_tokens)::numeric
       END AS volume,
       unit,
       sum(cost_usd) AS cost_usd
FROM usage_events
WHERE tenant IN ($tenant)
  AND coalesce(nullif(module, ''), '(unattributed)') IN ($module)
  AND coalesce(nullif(feature, ''), '(unlabelled)') IN ($feature)
  AND (${user:sqlstring} = '' OR subject_user = ${user:sqlstring})
  AND modality IN ($modality)
  AND coalesce(entity_type, '(none)') IN ($entity_type)
  AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
GROUP BY 1, 2, unit
ORDER BY cost_usd DESC

panels.title: Volume by modality
panels.description: What each modality actually consumed, in its own billing unit. Speech is billed by the second and TTS by the character, so a single volume number across modalities would be meaningless.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT modality,
       count(*) AS calls,
       sum(input_tokens + output_tokens) AS tokens,
       round(sum(audio_seconds)::numeric, 1) AS audio_seconds,
       sum(characters) AS characters,
       sum(CASE WHEN cost_known THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS unpriced,
       sum(cost_usd) AS cost_usd
FROM usage_events
WHERE tenant IN ($tenant)
  AND coalesce(nullif(module, ''), '(unattributed)') IN ($module)
  AND coalesce(nullif(feature, ''), '(unlabelled)') IN ($feature)
  AND (${user:sqlstring} = '' OR subject_user = ${user:sqlstring})
  AND modality IN ($modality)
  AND coalesce(entity_type, '(none)') IN ($entity_type)
  AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY cost_usd DESC

panels.title: Cost by modality
panels.description: Split of spend between LLM, speech-to-text and text-to-speech.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT modality, sum(cost_usd) AS cost
FROM usage_events
WHERE tenant IN ($tenant)
  AND coalesce(nullif(module, ''), '(unattributed)') IN ($module)
  AND coalesce(nullif(feature, ''), '(unlabelled)') IN ($feature)
  AND (${user:sqlstring} = '' OR subject_user = ${user:sqlstring})
  AND modality IN ($modality)
  AND coalesce(entity_type, '(none)') IN ($entity_type)
  AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY cost DESC

panels.title: Avg cost per entity

targets.rawSql:
-- An entity costs what all of its calls cost together — LLM, STT and TTS — so
-- the mean has to be taken over entities, AFTER summing each one. Averaging
-- cost_usd across rows answers a different question: the cost of an average
-- CALL, which for a live conversation is dominated by hundreds of tiny STT flushes
-- and is roughly three orders of magnitude smaller.
--
-- Rows with no entity are excluded rather than folded into one bucket. Cron,
-- backfills and request-shaped traffic would otherwise collapse into a single
-- enormous "entity" whose cost is the sum of all of them. Grouped by the
-- pair because an id is only unique within its type.
SELECT avg(entity_cost) AS "Avg cost"
FROM (
  SELECT entity_type, entity_id,
         sum(cost_usd) AS entity_cost
  FROM usage_events
  WHERE tenant IN ($tenant)
  AND coalesce(nullif(module, ''), '(unattributed)') IN ($module)
  AND coalesce(nullif(feature, ''), '(unlabelled)') IN ($feature)
  AND (${user:sqlstring} = '' OR subject_user = ${user:sqlstring})
  AND modality IN ($modality)
  AND coalesce(entity_type, '(none)') IN ($entity_type)
  AND coalesce(entity_id, '') <> ''
  AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
  GROUP BY entity_type, entity_id
) s

panels.description: An entity is one unit of work of the selected Entity type. Calls with no entity are left out of this row. Selecting several types averages them together.

targets.rawSql:
-- Read this next to the mean. Entity cost is long-tailed — one long
-- entity sits beside hundreds of short ones — so the mean tracks the tail and
-- the median tracks the typical entity. mean >> median means a handful of
-- entities are carrying the bill, and the mean is the wrong number to size
-- per-user economics with.
--
-- The cast is required, not cosmetic: percentile_cont takes double precision,
-- and cost_usd is NUMERIC.
SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY entity_cost::float)
         AS "Median cost"
FROM (
  SELECT entity_type, entity_id,
         sum(cost_usd) AS entity_cost
  FROM usage_events
  WHERE tenant IN ($tenant)
  AND coalesce(nullif(module, ''), '(unattributed)') IN ($module)
  AND coalesce(nullif(feature, ''), '(unlabelled)') IN ($feature)
  AND (${user:sqlstring} = '' OR subject_user = ${user:sqlstring})
  AND modality IN ($modality)
  AND coalesce(entity_type, '(none)') IN ($entity_type)
  AND coalesce(entity_id, '') <> ''
  AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
  GROUP BY entity_type, entity_id
) s

SELECT count(DISTINCT (entity_type, entity_id)) AS "Count"
FROM usage_events
WHERE tenant IN ($tenant)
  AND coalesce(nullif(module, ''), '(unattributed)') IN ($module)
  AND coalesce(nullif(feature, ''), '(unlabelled)') IN ($feature)
  AND (${user:sqlstring} = '' OR subject_user = ${user:sqlstring})
  AND modality IN ($modality)
  AND coalesce(entity_type, '(none)') IN ($entity_type)
  AND coalesce(entity_id, '') <> ''
  AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at)

-- Wall clock from an entity's first metered call to its last. For an entity
-- metered live this is a FLOOR on its length: the relay only sees it
-- while it is calling a provider, so silence before the first utterance and
-- after the last is invisible. For one worked on after the fact
-- — transcribed or reported later — it is how long that work was spread out.
--
-- It is here to tell "entities got longer" apart from "entities got pricier"
-- when the average cost moves — not to bill anyone by the minute. Divided by
-- nothing: the panel unit is seconds, so Grafana does the formatting and no
-- float/decimal division is introduced.
SELECT avg(extract(epoch FROM (ended_at - started_at))) AS "Avg length"
FROM (
  SELECT entity_type, entity_id,
         min(occurred_at) AS started_at,
         max(occurred_at) AS ended_at
  FROM usage_events
  WHERE tenant IN ($tenant)
  AND coalesce(nullif(module, ''), '(unattributed)') IN ($module)
  AND coalesce(nullif(feature, ''), '(unlabelled)') IN ($feature)
  AND (${user:sqlstring} = '' OR subject_user = ${user:sqlstring})
  AND modality IN ($modality)
  AND coalesce(entity_type, '(none)') IN ($entity_type)
  AND coalesce(entity_id, '') <> ''
  AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
  GROUP BY entity_type, entity_id
) s

panels.title: Avg cost per entity over time

targets.rawSql:
-- Each entity is bucketed by when it STARTED, so it is counted once at a
-- single point instead of being smeared across every bucket it touched.
--
-- Entities straddling the edge of the time range are truncated by
-- $__timeFilter and read cheaper than they were. That is negligible over a day
-- and material over an hour: at short ranges this line understates.
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(started_at, $__interval),
       avg(entity_cost) AS "Avg cost"
FROM (
  SELECT entity_type, entity_id,
         min(occurred_at) AS started_at,
         sum(cost_usd) AS entity_cost
  FROM usage_events
  WHERE tenant IN ($tenant)
  AND coalesce(nullif(module, ''), '(unattributed)') IN ($module)
  AND coalesce(nullif(feature, ''), '(unlabelled)') IN ($feature)
  AND (${user:sqlstring} = '' OR subject_user = ${user:sqlstring})
  AND modality IN ($modality)
  AND coalesce(entity_type, '(none)') IN ($entity_type)
  AND coalesce(entity_id, '') <> ''
  AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
  GROUP BY entity_type, entity_id
) s
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

-- Each modality's share of the AVERAGE entity — denominator is every entity
-- in the window, not just the entities that used that modality. An entity that
-- made no TTS call spent zero on TTS, and dividing by only the entities that did
-- use it would overstate what TTS adds to a typical one.
--
-- entities_using is kept alongside precisely so the two are distinguishable: a
-- modality used by half the entities at twice the cost looks identical in
-- avg_per_entity to one used by all of them at half.
WITH s AS (
  SELECT entity_type, entity_id, modality, cost_usd
  FROM usage_events
  WHERE tenant IN ($tenant)
  AND coalesce(nullif(module, ''), '(unattributed)') IN ($module)
  AND coalesce(nullif(feature, ''), '(unlabelled)') IN ($feature)
  AND (${user:sqlstring} = '' OR subject_user = ${user:sqlstring})
  AND modality IN ($modality)
  AND coalesce(entity_type, '(none)') IN ($entity_type)
  AND coalesce(entity_id, '') <> ''
  AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
),
n AS (SELECT count(DISTINCT (entity_type, entity_id)) AS entities FROM s)
SELECT s.modality,
       count(DISTINCT (s.entity_type, s.entity_id)) AS entities_using,
       round(sum(s.cost_usd), 4) AS total_usd,
       round(sum(s.cost_usd) / nullif(n.entities, 0), 6) AS avg_per_entity
FROM s CROSS JOIN n
GROUP BY s.modality, n.entities
ORDER BY total_usd DESC

panels.title: Effective rate by model
panels.description: What each model actually charged per unit of work, derived from the ledger rather than read from pricing.toml. This is the number that moves when a provider changes price, a caller switches model, or a surcharge lands that the rate table does not know about.

targets.rawSql:
-- Each modality bills in a different unit, so there is no single rate column
-- that would mean anything: tokens are priced per million, characters per
-- million, audio per hour. The unit is carried beside the number so the two are
-- never read apart.
--
-- This is the panel that makes a provider switch legible. Two TTS models both
-- priced "per character" are not comparable until the rate is computed, and the
-- gap can be large — a 6x spread between two voices is not visible anywhere in
-- a cost total.
--
-- unit is GROUPED, not aggregated with max(). A model does not always bill one
-- way: scribe_v2 records 312,861 calls in 'seconds' and 143 in 'tokens', and
-- max() returns 'tokens' because it sorts later — which would compute the rate
-- of the biggest STT model from a token count of zero and print NULL. Grouping
-- keeps each row internally consistent and makes the odd 143 visible instead of
-- letting them corrupt the row that matters.
--
-- Those stray rows are real: a call with a provider-stated cost and no
-- measurable quantity records the default unit. A NULL rate against a non-zero
-- cost is the signature, and it is worth noticing rather than hiding.
--
-- Every division is guarded by nullif, so such a row yields an empty cell
-- rather than a divide-by-zero that blanks the whole panel.
SELECT model,
       provider,
       unit,
       count(*) AS calls,
       sum(cost_usd) AS cost_usd,
       CASE unit
         WHEN 'tokens'     THEN round(sum(cost_usd) / nullif(sum(input_tokens + output_tokens), 0) * 1000000, 2)
         WHEN 'characters' THEN round(sum(cost_usd) / nullif(sum(characters), 0) * 1000000, 2)
         WHEN 'seconds'    THEN round(sum(cost_usd) / nullif(sum(audio_seconds), 0) * 3600, 2)
       END AS rate,
       CASE unit
         WHEN 'tokens'     THEN '$/Mtok'
         WHEN 'characters' THEN '$/Mchar'
         WHEN 'seconds'    THEN '$/audio-hour'
       END AS rate_unit
FROM usage_events
WHERE tenant IN ($tenant)
  AND coalesce(nullif(module, ''), '(unattributed)') IN ($module)
  AND coalesce(nullif(feature, ''), '(unlabelled)') IN ($feature)
  AND (${user:sqlstring} = '' OR subject_user = ${user:sqlstring})
  AND modality IN ($modality)
  AND coalesce(entity_type, '(none)') IN ($entity_type)
  AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
ORDER BY cost_usd DESC

panels.title: Prompt cache by module (LLM)
panels.description: Where the caching lever actually is. The headline hit-rate stat is one number for the whole fleet; this splits it by module and puts spend beside it, because a low rate only matters in proportion to what the module spends.

targets.rawSql:
-- Cached input bills at roughly a tenth of the normal input rate, so the
-- product of spend and (1 - hit_rate) is the money still on the table. Sorted
-- by spend rather than by rate deliberately: a module at 0% that spends nothing
-- is noise, and one at 5% that is third on the bill is the whole point.
--
-- LLM only. Speech and image rows carry no prompt tokens and would sit at a
-- permanent 0% for reasons that have nothing to do with caching.
--
-- Both operands cast: CRDB's sum() over BIGINT yields DECIMAL and it rejects
-- the float/decimal division Postgres would silently coerce. HAVING drops
-- modules with no input tokens at all rather than showing them as 0%.
SELECT coalesce(nullif(module, ''), '(unattributed)') AS module,
       sum(input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
       CASE WHEN sum(input_tokens) = 0 THEN 0
            ELSE sum(cached_input_tokens)::float / sum(input_tokens)::float
       END AS hit_rate,
       sum(cost_usd) AS cost_usd
FROM usage_events
WHERE tenant IN ($tenant)
  AND coalesce(nullif(module, ''), '(unattributed)') IN ($module)
  AND coalesce(nullif(feature, ''), '(unlabelled)') IN ($feature)
  AND (${user:sqlstring} = '' OR subject_user = ${user:sqlstring})
  AND modality IN ($modality)
  AND coalesce(entity_type, '(none)') IN ($entity_type)
  AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
  AND modality = 'llm'
GROUP BY 1
HAVING sum(input_tokens) > 0
ORDER BY cost_usd DESC

panels.title: Cost by feature
panels.description: feature is the finest label callers attach — 33 distinct values against module’s 20 — and it is the level at which a cost is attributable to a piece of product. Cost per call is the column the bar gauge cannot show.

targets.rawSql:
-- Grouped by feature AND module, because a feature name is only unique within
-- its module: speech_synthesis exists under the voice agent's coach module and under
-- the backend's tts module, and they are different pieces of product with different bills.
--
-- cost_per_call is what the Cost-by-feature bar gauge cannot show. A feature can
-- dominate the bill through volume or through price, and the two want different
-- fixes: half a million cheap transcription calls and a few thousand expensive
-- report generations both reach the top of a cost ranking, but only one of them
-- is fixed by making the call cheaper.
--
-- max(modality) is a label, not an aggregate that means anything: a feature
-- normally has exactly one. It is there so the unit of cost_per_call is
-- readable without cross-referencing another panel.
SELECT coalesce(nullif(feature, ''), '(unlabelled)') AS feature,
       coalesce(nullif(module, ''), '(unattributed)') AS module,
       max(modality) AS modality,
       count(*) AS calls,
       sum(cost_usd) AS cost_usd,
       round(sum(cost_usd) / nullif(count(*), 0), 6) AS cost_per_call
FROM usage_events
WHERE tenant IN ($tenant)
  AND coalesce(nullif(module, ''), '(unattributed)') IN ($module)
  AND coalesce(nullif(feature, ''), '(unlabelled)') IN ($feature)
  AND (${user:sqlstring} = '' OR subject_user = ${user:sqlstring})
  AND modality IN ($modality)
  AND coalesce(entity_type, '(none)') IN ($entity_type)
  AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY cost_usd DESC
LIMIT 30
